en.headline: Hang Seng closes 344 points lower at a three-month low
en.dek: The index finished at 23,785 after a second straight fall, with financial and AI-related shares leading the decline.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 344 points, or more than 1.4 per cent, lower at 23,785 on Thursday, a three-month closing low, according to RTHK. The market fell for a second session and spent the afternoon below 24,000 after slipping through that level at midday.

Turnover rose to about 207.3 billion dollars as mainland markets reopened after the National Day holiday and southbound trading resumed. Financial shares were broadly sold. HSBC, Bank of China, Standard Chartered and Bank of East Asia fell about 5 to 6 per cent, and Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing lost more than 1 per cent. AIA was steady.

The Hang Seng Tech Index fell about 2.9 per cent to 4,073, holding above 4,000. Chip and AI-related names were weaker: Hua Hong dropped more than 9 per cent and MiniMax nearly 14 per cent. Biren Technology fell nearly 12 per cent after placing shares at a discount of nearly 10 per cent to raise more than 4 billion dollars, its second placement in three months.

Mainland property shares moved against the broader market. China Resources Land and China Overseas Land rose nearly 3 per cent or more. The three major mainland oil stocks gained more than 2 per cent, and mainland bank shares were mostly steady.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌344點 創三個月低位
zh.dek: 指數收報23785點，連跌兩日，金融股及人工智能相關股份領跌。
body: 港股星期四再跌。據香港電台報道，恒生指數收報23785點，跌344點，跌幅逾1.4%，是三個月收市低位。指數連跌兩個交易日，下午跌幅擴大，收市仍失守24000點。
內地股市國慶長假後復市，北水恢復，港股成交額增至約2073億元。金融股普遍受壓，滙控、中銀、渣打及東亞跌約5%至6%，港交所跌逾1%，友邦靠穩。
恒生科技指數跌約2.9%，收報4073點，仍守住4000點。晶片及人工智能相關股份偏弱，華虹跌逾9%，MINIMAX跌近14%。壁仞科技跌近12%；公司以近一成折讓配股，集資逾40億元，是三個月內第二次配股。
內房股逆市上升，華潤置地及中海外升近3%或以上。內地三大油股升逾2%，內銀股則普遍靠穩。
